title: Coeur D'Alene Parasail
specs: Parasail up to 500 feet above Lake Coeur d'Alene
Only parasailing experience in the Pacific Northwest
Parasailing flights require minimum combined weight of 200 lbs and maximum combined weight of 450 lbs
Around age 4 is minimum for parasail harness fit
Triple flights allow up to 3 flyers

gap: Age minimum for watersport rentals not stated
blurb: Guests can parasail up to 500 feet above Lake Coeur d'Alene with flights lasting about 10 minutes. Watersport rentals include paddle boards, kayaks, and paddle boats for exploring the lake. The business operates from a dock at Independence Point, just west of the Coeur d'Alene Resort.
extraNote: Arrive 15 minutes early for parasailing check-in · No parasailing in wind over 15 mph, rain, or lightning within 10 miles · If cancelled due to weather, refund or reschedule offered · Cancel 6+ hours before for full refund; less than 6 hours 50% charge; no-shows charged full amount · Observers on boat are $10, first-come first-served, max 10 passengers per Coast Guard · Independence Point City Dock, 110 S. 1st Street, Coeur d'Alene, ID 83814, just west of the Coeur d'Alene Resort
